detail: The regrade log rejections are grounded: four wrong verdicts were re-derived from their cited lines and all four hold. The two findings are documentation-accuracy defects in how the document describes its own exclusions and its guard count.

direction: The wrong verdicts as a pattern of over-rejection
reason: Four were re-derived from their cited lines and all four hold.

direction: The 59 dual-status origins as a defect in the regrade log itself
reason: The log reason text usually says which part survived, so the log is internally honest; the defect is in section 1 absolute rule.

direction: The out-of-scope verdicts as hiding a phase gap
reason: The sampled ones either belong to a phase outside the fourteen or survive as a net-new candidate.
